screen_names_and_descriptions: 21c267ef898a5960eea0d8cc0c93ea6eb54b46d154921ccbd6255d36be1f406f - Start state: This is the start state with no visible user interface shown. No screen content or interactive elements are provided for this state.

98690af4e4e2db616e01702fea45eb91c76510060bbd2b1f06bf6ca19581fa97 - GrantPermissionsActivity(Window=Main): This permission dialog asks whether Family Finance can send and view SMS messages. It shows a permission icon, the message text, and two buttons: Deny and Allow. The user can reject or grant SMS access from this screen.

23d6f907f0cb794acd2cc1593a2ab2d926b51585b29facc3b6ad4d9fab9ad2a9 - DashboardActivity: This is the main Family Finance dashboard with a toolbar, an Open navigation button, and the title shown at the top. A scrollable menu presents buttons for Accounts, Expenses, Incomes, Transfers, Flow of Funds, Templates, Sms Patterns, and Reports. Additional add buttons next to Expenses, Incomes, and Transfers let the user start creating those entries directly.

2701a29a01715945a1faf1a0578c10ffb9496390d483166e3540bcdad9603536 - IncomeOperationEditActivity(Window=Main): This screen is used to edit an income entry and includes a top bar with Navigate up and Save actions. The form contains fields for Article Name, Article Category, Income Account, Owner, Value, Date, Currency, and Exchange Rate, along with an icon at the top. The user can enter or modify income details and save the changes from this page.

a8ea42ee84b2eb016ce6fd4a82c100c85533ca851424f13c19bd4648c20afff6 - TemplateActivity(Window=Main): This screen displays the Templates section with a toolbar containing Navigate up and More options. The main content area is a recycler view inside an entity fragment, indicating a scrollable list of templates. The user can view the template list and access additional actions from the toolbar menu.

f2429a067840e7a366d49127ac598952058d21b9b31e22f3fd5d9fb3819a9e59 - TransferOperationEditActivity(Window=Main): This screen is for editing a transfer and has a toolbar with Navigate up and Save actions. The form includes fields for Owner, Expense Account, Income Account, Value, Date, Currency, and Exchange Rate, with an icon displayed near the top. The user can edit transfer details and save the updated transfer from this screen.

cbb0534741de39a1bb8fd016708f4263a755f94b48173b17f889df6852a5f3ee - ExpenseOperationActivity: This Expenses screen has a toolbar with Navigate up, Filter, and Add Entry actions. The main area contains a recycler view for expense items and a balance section that shows the label Balance and the current value 0. The user can browse expenses, apply a filter, add a new expense entry, and review the total balance.

4aa7e61d3320dd16f03801825c0866ef1d601202697dc89752c7915c90bbf365 - ExpenseOperationActivity(Window=Main): This dialog is titled Expenses Filter and provides fields to narrow the expense list. It includes inputs for Article, Currency, Account, Owner, Start Date, End Date, Start Value, and End Value. Cancel and OK buttons let the user dismiss the dialog or apply the selected expense filters.

ca9f79c616e72abd3b414dd4909c129e8d1f454c3c9c977875ed6c4dde56e178 - SmsPatternActivity: This screen shows the Sms Patterns section with a toolbar containing Navigate up and Add Entry. Its main content is a recycler view inside an entity fragment, representing a list of SMS patterns. The user can browse existing SMS patterns and start adding a new one from the toolbar.

df10a7e04ef4889d5fee50d42c33f22ba331ec2d43ce24ca8b4b26de65e40180 - CurrencyEditActivity(Window=Main): This screen is for editing a currency and includes a toolbar with Navigate up and Save. Below the toolbar are an icon and two text input fields labeled Name and Description. The user can enter or change currency information and save it from this page.

ff086dafb94c4763d213ba12caff3fe312b1403d44437056fc6f0e533ef0401b - SmsPatternEditActivity(Window=Main): This screen is used to edit an SMS pattern and includes Navigate up and Save in the toolbar. The form provides fields for Name (required), Template Name, Sender, and Regular Expression, plus a Common switch that is currently off. The user can configure the basic SMS pattern details and save the pattern from this screen.

045999488da64db90df09512fd8195752a90293cf360def40728d2471e6230e0 - SmsPatternEditActivity: This SMS Pattern Edit screen extends the form with additional parsing fields beyond the basic pattern information. It includes Name, a Common switch, Template Name, Sender, Regular Expression, Date Group, and Value Group, along with a Save action in the toolbar. The user can define both the SMS matching pattern and the groups used to extract date and value information.

3e6a2826128216c8584c2c156e0d4a27e194932d71230da2b36e5bc74d671ff7 - SmsPatternEditActivity: This screen shows a toolbar titled Templates with a Navigate up button at the top. The main content area contains a recycler view inside an entity fragment, indicating a list-based template display. The user can view the template list and return using the navigation control.

eb11e43fb68de36fde35b98680b866cdc44aca80736896e3c983dde1de1c1c87 - End state: This is the end state with no visible user interface shown. No screen content or interactive elements are provided for this state.

caead4a7727e1c1f5cfd36bf05391cf318af588ab6d690f93472bdf8c7bb0e91 - ChartActivity: This Reports screen includes a toolbar with Navigate up, Filter, and Display actions. Below it, sliding tabs let the user switch among Expenses/Incomes, Expenses by Articles, and Incomes by Articles views, while the content area shows a bar chart. The user can change report categories and adjust filtering or display settings from this screen.

b64ffe8e6233b7b997e733e3f12f6556f75e76d0ead17ea4b8bd621253867af1 - ChartActivity: This Reports screen has the same toolbar and tab navigation for Expenses/Incomes, Expenses by Articles, and Incomes by Articles. In this version, the chart area displays a horizontal bar chart instead of a standard bar chart. The user can browse report tabs and use the Filter or Display actions to modify the report view.

c73baec5341ca7597ddef244067a27040e0496b4ead7b7f27231070848c360d0 - ChartActivity: This Reports screen presents tabs for Expenses by Articles, Incomes by Articles, and Expenses by Articles (Pie Chart). The content area currently shows a horizontal bar chart, and the toolbar still provides Navigate up, Filter, and Display controls. The user can switch between article-based report views and adjust report settings from the toolbar.

01a341ea75bccc28990a34da91f2f22438fc9bcc9af7129e191e44d0090a128a - ChartActivity: This Reports screen shows tabs for Incomes by Articles, Expenses by Articles (Pie Chart), and Incomes by Articles (Pie Chart). The main report area displays a pie chart, and the toolbar includes Navigate up, Filter, and Display actions. The user can view pie-chart-based report breakdowns and change the current report configuration.

72adbf5e593cea0b2062b6b9c16d753fb36e3c783946a4a8d7356471106c80cd - ChartActivity: This Reports screen focuses on pie chart report tabs for Expenses by Articles (Pie Chart) and Incomes by Articles (Pie Chart). A pie chart is shown in the main content area, with Filter and Display actions available in the toolbar. The user can switch between the two pie chart report categories and refine how the report is shown.

8230c5642c2f1cae14743e0539d20e3fbc1985c000a155eab7da60ad3fbd1e59 - ChartActivity(Window=Main): This dialog is titled Filter of Incomes by Articles (Pie Chart) and is used to filter report results. It contains fields for Article, Currency, Account, Owner, Start Date, End Date, Start Value, and End Value. Cancel and OK buttons allow the user to discard the settings or apply the report filter.

f189f23124c6c372973bbff27e30b7107f27022f74836d7085daf2817f565790 - ChartActivity(Window=Main): This dialog is titled Display of Incomes by Articles and controls how the report is presented. It offers Group by options for Article and Article parent, and View options with checkboxes for View values and Use percent values. Cancel and OK buttons let the user close the dialog or confirm the display settings.

2957d1cfee327d06abd84e6b91e1153eb930ce1886a45ed33c8ff4c6536fbcb0 - debug): This is a system error dialog stating that Family Finance has stopped. The message is shown in a scrollable area with a single OK button below it. The user can acknowledge the crash notification by pressing OK.

4bfa8dc7a47495036edd455e67d3d7f39276498a2ed0a8d362a59d5c7b005b38 - ChartActivity: This screen shows the Display of Incomes by Articles dialog for configuring report presentation. It includes radio options for grouping by Article or Article parent and checkboxes for View values and Use percent values, followed by CANCEL and OK buttons. The user can adjust display preferences for the report and then cancel or confirm the selection.

d39c2c754950166798705365a33ee5104463a282c70fbcd711ff3d9f25a7e75b - debugApplication: This is a crash dialog stating that Family Finance has stopped. It presents the alert title and a single button labeled Open app again. The user can use this button to restart the application.

1370dcc2f8d66f21cb475cfc8556ad3f9854fc0950c15582e2843d687cd557df - ExpenseOperationEditActivity: This screen is for editing an expense and includes Navigate up and Save actions in the toolbar. The form contains fields for Article Name, Article Category, Expense Account, Owner, Value, Date, Currency, Exchange Rate, Description (optional), and URL (optional), with an icon near the top. The user can fill in or update expense details and save the entry from this screen.

36815831bf995e75a0678ce627b43d46d8e514244f2b710ef80c415b6f6e4b81 - ExpenseOperationEditActivity: This screen shows the Expense Articles section with a toolbar containing Navigate up, Search, Add Entry, and More options. The main content is a recycler view inside an entity fragment, indicating a list of expense articles. The user can browse articles, search them, add a new article, or open more actions from the menu.

ec8b42819b7cd156177a3b12f51cf4bb2a15956511593da3351744ea670caf6c - ExpenseArticleActivity: This Expense Articles screen has a toolbar with Navigate up, Search, Add Entry, and More options. The main entity fragment is visible, but no list items are shown in the provided content. The user can access article-related actions from the toolbar and navigate within the section.

edb7420417e034ae12bad464e3520240077bd1b4c6c54203a6e8ab0d12c034ea - AccountActivity: This Accounts screen includes a toolbar with Navigate up, Add Entry, and More options. The main content area contains a recycler view inside an entity fragment, representing a scrollable list of accounts. The user can browse accounts, add a new account, or open additional menu options.

eaac9b00d1c80dd5f904609080ef1eef072f385fbd5bf8cb93134ac056f94b26 - DashboardActivity: This is the Family Finance dashboard with the navigation drawer opened and a Close button in the toolbar. The drawer lists sections including Currencies, Exchange Rates, People, Expense Articles, Income Articles, Backup, Settings, and Contact, while the main dashboard still shows buttons for Accounts, Expenses, Incomes, Transfers, Flow of Funds, Templates, Sms Patterns, and Reports. The user can choose a section from the drawer or use the dashboard shortcuts and add buttons for expense, income, and transfer creation.

83d4d644948d7747a3293f2ae95a57fd391f3be3164eb01736c5a3727ae2ffde - WelcomeTourActivity(Window=Main): This screen is a welcome tour page from Gmail, not Family Finance. It shows the Gmail logo, the title Welcome to Gmail, the text One app for all of your email, a page indicator, and Skip and Next controls. The user can skip the tour or move to the next introduction page.

39c0cba34d2b959df3bfbca4bea67971d5b18dd222a09b836cc655f6c8824659 - SettingsActivity(Window=Main): This Settings screen has a toolbar with Navigate up and a list of preference categories. The visible options are Interface, Database, Backup & Restore, and ACRA, each with a short summary beneath the title. The user can open one of these settings groups to manage that part of the application configuration.

3ebce10e50f37e13423d3c33d043f346be2662cf146215ffc36ad59a34e6af68 - SettingsActivity(Window=Main): This Settings screen shows a single ACRA-related preference entry. The item is titled Enable ACRA, has the summary ACRA is enabled, and includes a checkbox on the right. The user can review or toggle the crash reporting setting from this page.

df0a3aa3f5ce1405b8b49153dbb30a5d3dc00a48c687ded2989d38c10f2b84be - SettingsActivity(Window=Main): This Settings screen lists database-related default values and initial configuration entries. The visible items are Default currency, Default account, Default person, Article of expenses, Article of incomes, and Transfer article, each accompanied by an explanatory summary. The user can review these defaults and open them to change the stored database-related settings.

0d2c754fd2d0c34f16fd30929b1fa1564d47cf830d327969ab2c30193473ab35 - SettingsActivity(Window=Main): This Settings screen shows a Backup path preference entry. The item displays the title Backup path and the summary Not specified. The user can view or choose the backup location from this settings page.

4eb1d66423d13194a4cdd7289cf2f84c3ea49cb55f7dced58ce2b7885517d47e - BackupActivity(Window=Main): This Backup & Restore screen includes a toolbar with Navigate up and a vertical set of action buttons. The buttons are Make a backup of DB, Restore the backup of DB, Make a backup of shared preferences, and Restore the backup of shared preferences. The user can start backup or restore operations for the database and shared preferences from this page.

61730fee40943d7766d05209a78150c6b3cb5f45ca1cfb072a033c4a76ccf37a - GrantPermissionsActivity(Window=Main): This permission dialog asks whether Family Finance can access photos, media, and files on the device. It shows a permission icon, the permission message, and Deny and Allow buttons. The user can reject or grant storage-related access from this screen.

be293305925b6bc1b0d14db30d275d01f79d7459a7492f0c828ec16b0c9369cc - ExchangeRateActivity(Window=Main): This Exchange Rates screen has a toolbar with Navigate up, Filter, and Add Entry. The main content area contains a recycler view inside an entity fragment, indicating a list of exchange rates. The user can browse exchange rates, filter the list, or add a new entry.

bac05800a221f33162bd4e70d05cb2cb56c3a1ce70feb612e22219defecc036b - ExchangeRateActivity(Window=Main): This dialog is titled Exchange Rate Filter and is used to narrow the exchange rate list. It contains fields for Currency, Start Date, End Date, Start Value, and End Value. Cancel and OK buttons let the user close the dialog or apply the selected filter criteria.

332580246c8aeb4b5057e22f0e3b054f9dc78fe095da958115e428efc5aca102 - SettingsActivity: This Settings screen presents the main categories in a list container under a toolbar titled Settings. The visible options are Interface, Database, Backup & Restore, and ACRA, each with an icon, title, and summary. The user can select one of these categories to open more detailed settings.
